messages:
anna_sales: Quick heads-up — AcmeMed requires a wet-ink paper signature for the initial order and bank wire remittance. PO PO-8234 attached. They want the original mailed to their DE office. Need to route signature and confirm delegated signer. cc @kevin_legal @maria_finance

kevin_legal: Paper signatures are OK but require an exception approval. Do we have any customer redlines on the DPA/SCCs or export controls? :thinking:

maria_finance: They asked for net30 and will wire. We need remittance fields + VAT ID to map to our billing system. Is treasury OK with receiving a wire rather than card/ACH? @paul_ops

jordan_se: From SE side: this is for Redwood Dedicated (4x GPU reservation). Pricing note: this order uses the enterprise SKU with a 10% discount — quoted $69,000/mo. Make sure order form line items match SOW.

kevin_legal: I uploaded a marked MSA with two redlines: (1) acceptance of wet-ink as an alternative signature method, (2) tightened DPA export language. I'll prepare a DocuSign fallback but need to know who can sign on Redwood's behalf if we do mail. Who is authorized? @paul_ops @anna_sales

anna_sales: Historically we use VP Sales or GC. For speed, can we use a delegated signer for PO acceptance? Need to know process/time.

paul_ops: Ops can accept PO/PO-equivalents up to $100k/mo via delegated signer. I'll confirm signatory list and add the delegation record to the contract folder.

docusign-bot: DocuSign envelope created: env_0a9f. Link: https://docusign.example/envelope/env_0a9f

anna_sales: Customer insists on original mailed copy to their DE address and won't accept purely digital record for procurement. Proposed approach: countersign digitally so finance can invoice, then mail the original wet-signed copy within 5 business days. Thoughts?

kevin_legal: That's acceptable as an exception. Add clause to order form: "Original wet-signed copy will be mailed within 5 business days of countersignature." We should also confirm chain-of-custody for the mailed original (tracking, address).

zoe_security: Quick flag on SCC annex changes — the customer's DPA redlines include a bespoke data export clause. I need to review the exact text before greenlighting. Please attach their redlined DPA here.

jordan_se: Dropped the customer's DPA and SCC annex as comments in the doc and pasted the critical clause in-thread.

maria_finance: For wiring we need: beneficiary name, bank name, IBAN/BIC, remittance reference, VAT ID, and AP contact. Also confirm billing email for PDF invoice.

kevin_legal: Action items: (1) Anna to gather remittance + VAT + AP contact; (2) Paul to confirm delegated signer and attach delegation record; (3) Zoe to review SCC annex and sign off or escalate; (4) I will add the wet-ink clause and prepare signature routing (DocuSign fallback + physical mail instructions). ETA EOD tomorrow.

anna_sales: I'll collect remittance info today and ping Thomas at AcmeMed (Thomas@acmemed.com). Will upload the scanned redlines when received. :thumbsup:

paul_ops: Confirmed: delegated signers list includes Paul Ops and VP Sales. I'll put a PO acceptance template in the contract folder and note the $100k cap.

anna_sales: Thanks — will update this thread once I have Thomas' remittance info and the signed PDF scan. :eyes:
